purpose: Original animated Shorts in two accepted visual formats, not a one-click approval to publish

PAINTERLY_2D.intent: Atmospheric cinematic illustrated stories; layered snow, volumetric glow, deep blue-purple palette
PAINTERLY_2D.known_limit: A static illustration with camera zoom and weather effects is insufficient for character acting

HYBRID_2D3D.intent: Simple fixed-design 2D characters integrated with one physically consistent reusable Blender 3D world
pipeline: one vehicle model with sliding doors
HYBRID_2D3D.known_limit: Passing geometry and decode tests does not guarantee visual acceptability

global.narrator: GUSTAVA DEEP voice_id=deep; never silently replace
global.audio_master: audible onset must match first movement frame; trim source silence
global.publish_only_after: human visual approval, validated MP4, licensed audio, matching narration and action

critical_gate_cases: Door must be fully clear before the hero crosses threshold
Camera cannot crop face, body or produce unidentified foreground object during a required action
Foot placement must touch actual ground/platform
SFX door onset = geometric first moving frame, footsteps = first walking frame
Eye/hand/arm count stable and character identity consistent
